svg.title: A service, a layer, one file that composes the layers, and a test that swaps one
svg.desc: 1. The interface: Notes, in packages/core/src/notes.ts, has list and insert(title), which can fail with NotesUnavailable. createNote asks for Notes and never sees a layer. 2. A layer: NotesLive, in packages/db/src/notes.ts, implements Notes with queries on the note table. 3. One file composes: AppLayer, in apps/web/src/server/layers.ts, lists DatabaseLayer, which holds NotesLive, and AuthLive. 4. A test swaps the layer: in packages/core/test/notes.test.ts, NotesInMemory also implements Notes and keeps notes in memory; layer(NotesInMemory) provides it in place of NotesLive.
